about: Joyce Gist Lewis is a highly credentialed advocate who has earned the respect of her peers in and out of the courtroom. Joyce’s twenty-five years of experience include serving as lead counsel for claims involving professional liability, director and officer liability, business divorce, real estate litigation, employment discrimination defense, and catastrophic injury defense. She is also "go-to" counsel for clients seeking help in matters involving constitutional rights, election law, and sensitive intra-agency investigations. Joyce's reputation as a principled trial advocate has resulted in her being named to the “short-list” of nominees recommended by Georgia’s Judicial Nominating Commission for appointment to the Georgia Court of Appeals in 2018 and to the Atlanta Judicial Circuit in 2011 and 2012. Her appellate experience includes arguing cases before the Eleventh Circuit Court of Appeals and successfully petitioning for certiorari to Georgia’s Supreme Court.

Joyce received her BA, magna cum laude, from Wake Forest University (1993) and her law degree from Georgia State University College of Law (1999). She is Martindale-Hubbell AV-rated Preeminent and has been repeatedly rated by her peers as one of the Top 100 Lawyers in Georgia and one of the Top 50 Women. Joyce’s past leadership positions include serving as President of the Lawyers Club of Atlanta, President of the Board of the Federal Defender Program, Inc., and President of the Georgia Association for Women Lawyers' Atlanta Chapter. She is a Master in GSU’s Bleckley Inn of Court, and in 2018 was elected to the State Bar of Georgia Board of Governors, where she serves on the Executive Committee, the Advisory Committee on Legislation, the Statewide Judicial Evaluation Committee, and the Attorney Well-Being Committee. She was honored by the Georgia Bar in 2023 with the Chief Justice Thomas O. Marshall Professionalism Award, which is given to one Georgia lawyer each year, and she was previously the recipient of the Atlanta Bar Association’s Outstanding Woman in the Profession Award.
